title: Graded differential on retained augmentation representatives
statement: Let $\mathcal A$ be a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian], $K$ an integer-indexed cochain complex, and $I$ a bicomplex with complex index in $\mathbf Z$ and resolution index in $\mathbf N$ [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Set $J$ equal to the identity-mapped, resolution-extended-by-zero, flipped bicomplex [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $\epsilon:K\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ be a chain map and $C=\operatorname{Cone}(\epsilon)$ [lem-pur-quasi-iso-cone-acyclic]. Let $F$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $C$ [def-sp-filtration], and write $i_{p,n}:(F^pC)^n\to C^n$ and $q_{p,n}:(F^pC)^n\to G_p^n$ for its inclusion and graded quotient projection, where $G_p=F^pC/F^{p+1}C$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. Write $u_n:K^{n+1}\to C^n$ and $v_n:\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n\to C^n$ for the cone inclusions, $j_{r,s,n}:J^{r,s}\to\operatorname{Tot}(J)^n$ for the diagonal inclusion when $r+s=n$, and $j^0_{r,s,n}$ for that inclusion extended by zero when $r+s\ne n$. Fix $b\in\mathbf Z$, and assume for every $q,n$ that $F^qC^n=(\operatorname{im}(u_n)\text{ if }q\le n+1,\text{ else }0)+\sum_{s=\max(b,q)}^n\operatorname{im}(j^0_{n-s,s,n}v_n)$. Each extension identification $E_{s,r,t}:(I^{s,\bullet}\text{ extended by zero})^t\cong I^{s,r}$ is the canonical one for $t=r$. Let $a:K[0]\to I$ be a bicomplex map, where $K[0]$ is concentrated in resolution degree zero. Assume $\epsilon^n=a^{n,0}E_{n,0,0}^{-1}j_{0,n,n}$ for all $n$. Let $p,m,m'\in\mathbf Z$ with $m+1=p$ and $m+1=m'$. Suppose $l:K^p\to(F^pC)^m$ and $l':I^{p,0}\to(F^pC)^{m'}$ satisfy $li_{p,m}=u_m$ after the equality identification $K^p\cong K^{m+1}$, and $l'i_{p,m'}=E_{p,0,m'-p}^{-1}j_{m'-p,p,m'}v_{m'}$. Then $lq_{p,m}d_{G_p}^{m,m'}=a^{p,0}l'q_{p,m'}$. This concerns the augmentation term alone and assumes no comparison isomorphism or below-bound vanishing.

proof.text: The degree hypotheses give p=m+1=m'. The cone K inclusion at degree m+1 has image in F^{p+1}C^{m+1} by the first summand of the image-step formula. Factor it through the monic next-step inclusion using its image subobject.

Cancel the monic inclusion of F^pC^{m+1}. Chain compatibility of this inclusion and the cone left-inclusion differential formula give l d_step as the augmentation part minus d_K followed by the factorization from step 1. The prescribed formula for epsilon and the ambient inclusion equation for l' identify the augmentation part with a^{p,0}l'. Canonical extension maps for equal resolution-zero indices agree.

Use chain compatibility of q and distribute composition over subtraction. The next-step inclusion followed by q is zero by its defining cokernel relation. Thus the d_K part vanishes and the augmentation part is a^{p,0}l'q, giving the asserted equation.

theorem cartanEilenberg_cone_graded_augmentation_representative
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    (K : CochainComplex A ℤ)
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ((CochainComplex.single₀ A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj
      K ⟶ I)
    (b : ℤ)
    (aug : K ⟶ (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).total
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
    (haug : ∀ n : ℤ, aug.f n = (a.f n).f 0 ≫
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X n))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := 0) rfl).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0 n n (zero_add n))
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone aug))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n =
        (if p ≤ n + 1 then imageSubobject
          ((CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (n + 1) n (by omega)) else ⊥) ⊔
        (Finset.Icc (max b p) n).sup (fun s ↦ imageSubobject
          ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotalOrZero
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (n - s) s n ≫
              (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f n)))
    (p m m' : ℤ) (hm : m + 1 = p) (hmm' : m + 1 = m')
    (l : K.X p ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m)
    (l' : (I.X p).X 0 ⟶ (F.step p : CochainComplex A ℤ).X m')
    (hl : l ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m =
      (K.XIsoOfEq hm.symm).hom ≫
        (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inl aug).v (m + 1) m (by omega))
    (hl' : l' ≫ (F.step p).arrow.f m' =
      (HomologicalComplex.extendXIso
        (((𝟭 A).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X p))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := 0) (i' := m' - p)
        (by change (0 : ℤ) = m' - p; omega)).inv ≫
      (((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor (𝟭 A)).obj I).flip).ιTotal
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (m' - p) p m' (by change (m' - p) + p = m'; omega) ≫
      (CochainComplex.mappingCone.inr aug).f m') :
    l ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m ≫
        (F.gradedPiece p).d m m' =
      (a.f p).f 0 ≫ l' ≫ (F.complexQuotientπ p (p + 1) (by omega)).f m'
